sloka: अथातिरभसेनागाद्राहुरुत्सृज्य वासवम् ।अनेन च स वै दृष्टः प्रधावञ्छैलकूटवत् ।। ७.३५.३९ ॥
transliteration: athātirabhasenāgādrāhurutsṛjya vāsavam ।anena ca sa vai dṛṣṭaḥ pradhāvañchailakūṭavat ।। 7.35.39 ॥

translations.english: Then Rahu, leaving Indra, went with great speed, and he was indeed seen by Hanuman running swiftly like a mountain peak.
